name: Knighteater
_source: Monster Sheet (2 pages), AI/BP/Routine/Kingdom Trait card sheet, Signature card — owner scans 2026-11-17; reference sheet Knighteater; Clash Setup: expansion Codex p.50–51

footprint.rear: the 2 cells directly behind the footprint

traits.name: Starved Slaughterman
traits.text:
Additional Setup: At the start of the Clash each Knight may perform [Peril] to place 1 Fleisch token in the Knight Pool. If you draw a positive Mortis card, ignore its effects. If you draw a negative Mortis card, resolve it. Squires ignore this Additional Setup.

Wolf Down X: Discard X Fleisch tokens from the Knight Pool, then:
• If not Berserk, and you discarded less than X, the Knighteater immediately becomes Berserk.
• If not Berserk, and you discarded exactly X, Knighteater gains 1 Armor [Armor] token and remains not Berserk.
• If Berserk, and you discarded exactly X, the Knighteater stops being Berserk and gains 1 Armor [Armor] token.
• If Berserk, and you discarded less than X, a random adjacent Knight loses -X [V] and Knighteater remains Berserk.

traits.name: Frenzied Hunger
traits.text:
When the Knighteater becomes Berserk, place the [Priority Target] Priority Target token on its Sheet (Knights cannot gain the [Priority Target] token as long as it is on Knighteater’s Sheet).
While Berserk, all Knighteater Attacks, if two or more Knights are equally viable Targets of the Attack, become Sequential Attacks, and the Knighteater attacks all Targets starting from the closest.
When the Knighteater stops being Berserk, the Knight with the highest [P] gains the [Priority Target] token. If it stops being Berserk during an Attack, Chain Break that Attack.

traits.name: Meatbait
traits.text: When you attack, you may attack with -2 Precision to place X Fleisch tokens in the Knight Pool, where X is the Knighteater’s Level.

traits.name: Measured Movement
traits.text: The Knighteater does not destroy Terrain tiles when moving through them. When the Knighteater ends its movement on a Column Terrain tile, do not destroy it, move it to an adjacent space instead.

traits.name: Brute
traits.text: Each time the Knighteater gains a Wound (a Double Wound is treated as 2 Wounds) or gains an Armor [Armor] token, place a Generic token on this Trait. If there are 3 or more Generic tokens on this Trait, finish resolving the current action, discard all Generic tokens from this Trait and all Armor [Armor] tokens, then perform Signature.

traits.name: Glutton
traits.text: All BP cards without Ultrainstinct Responses gain: ULTRAINSTINCT [React]: Wolf Down X, where X is the Knighteater’s Level (as denoted on the BP cards).

traits.name: Living Up to the Name
traits.text: During Wolf Down X, if the Knighteater is Berserk and you discarded less than X, ignore the [V] loss, and a random adjacent Knight is devoured (dies) instead. Then, the Knighteater stops being Berserk.

traits.name: Feral Guard
traits.text: The Knighteater cannot be wounded if it is Berserk.

traits.name: Iron Confines
traits.text:
[Kingdom Trait — Principality of Stone] Start of Monster Round: If the Knighteater is not Berserk, it gains 1 Armor [Armor] token.

When the Knighteater stops being Berserk, it gains 1 Armor [Armor] token.

traits.name: Adaptable
traits.text: [Kingdom Trait — Sunken Kingdom] When the Knighteater ends its movement, if it moved through or onto a Terrain tile, place a 1x2 Swamp Terrain tile in its Blindspot spaces.

signature.name: A Succulent Meal
effects: For each hit lose -1 [V]. [Peril]. Three or more hits, gain the Fear Condition card.

routine.name: The Devouring
routine.text: Discard all Fleisch tokens from the Knight Pool. Knighteater moves to the closest Knight, then all adjacent Knights are devoured (die).

steps: Monster Positioning: Place the Knighteater miniature on the space designated on the diagram. To determine facing direction, look at the bottom card from the Minor Mortis deck. If the arrow in the lower left corner points ↑ or ↓, Knighteater is facing ↓. If the arrow points ← or →, Knighteater is facing ←.

Additional Setup: Depending on the Kingdom, take the Iron Confines (Principality of Stone) or Adaptable (Sunken Kingdom) Trait card. Follow additional Clash Setup instructions introduced by Traits (if any).
clashSetup.monsterFacing: bottom Minor Mortis arrow: ↑/↓ → facing ↓, ←/→ → facing ←
notes: 지형·시작 칸은 코덱스 도식에서 읽음 [해석, 확인 필요]

rulings: Armor 토큰: 개수만큼 모든 BP의 AT +1로 처리 (BP Level 구분 없음) [해석, 확인 필요]
Ultrainstinct: BP를 정한 직후, Power Roll 전에 처리 (Rulebook p.58). Crit Chance면 무시 (Eggknight와 같은 처리)
Frenzied Hunger: Berserk 동안 Priority Target 토큰은 Knighteater Sheet에 있고 기사는 얻을 수 없음. Targeting 동률이면 동률인 기사 전원을 가까운 순서로 이동·공격(Sequential). Berserk가 공격 중에 풀리면 그 공격은 Chain Break
Starved Slaughterman Additional Setup: 각 기사가 Peril check를 할지 선택 — 하면 Fleisch 토큰 1개. 긍정 Mortis 카드는 효과 무시
Meatbait: 공격 선언 시 선택 — Precision -2로 공격하고 Fleisch 토큰을 Knighteater Level만큼 Knight Pool에
Measured Movement: 이동 중 지나간 Column은 그대로 두고, 이동을 마쳤을 때 밑에 있는 Column은 인접한 빈 칸으로 옮김
Appear Behind (Rulebook): 대상에 인접한 위치 중 현재 위치에서 가장 먼 곳에 놓고 대상을 향함
Forced Vault (Rulebook): 인접한 기사를 Knighteater 반대편 인접 칸으로 옮김(비자발 이동). 보드 밖/파괴 불가 Obstacle이면 사망. "If this Vault would cause Crash, [Peril] instead": 도착 칸이 Obstacle/다른 미니어처면 Peril check로 대체 [해석, 확인 필요]
Drag X: Knighteater가 대상 반대쪽으로 X칸 이동하고 대상이 같은 방향으로 따라옴 (인접해야 시작)
Lowest / Highest Peril Threshold: Uninjured < Minor < Major < Grave < Judicium 순 [해석, 확인 필요]
"Closest Squire" Targeting 줄: Squire 미구현이라 건너뜀
Debilitating Crush Targeting 첫 줄: "Knight with a [Two-handed] Weapon" (소유자 확인 2026-11-17) — Two-handed 무기를 든 기사 중 가장 가까운 기사
카드 맨 위 "Wolf Down X"(9장): 그 앞에 REACT! 창, Wolf Down은 Targeting보다 먼저 해결 (소유자 확인 2026-11-17)
Penetrate (Armor Cracker, Debilitating Crush, Can Opener, Offal Harvest, Blood-Drenched Butchery, Heat 게이트 3장): 키워드 정의 미확인 — 미구현
devoured (die): 즉사. Cannibal’s Mouthpiece Critical 이후에는 Judicium Draw로 대체
"You may voluntarily end this Attack before performing a Power Roll" (Cannibal’s Mouthpiece, Monstrous Stomach): Ultrainstinct 뒤에 물음. 끝내면 Knight Pool을 비우고 Response 없이 BP는 버림 [해석, 확인 필요]
